title: Server Update 3.2 --- New Vehicles & Properties
excerpt: 15 new vehicles, 8 new properties, and a complete overhaul of the housing system.
content: We are excited to announce Server Update 3.2! This update brings 15 new vehicles, 8 new properties across San Andreas, and a complete overhaul of the housing system. Check out the full changelog in our Discord.

title: Double XP Weekend Event
excerpt: Earn double experience points for all activities this weekend only.
content: This weekend only, earn double experience points for all activities including jobs, faction missions, and more. Don't miss out on this opportunity to level up fast!

title: Scheduled Maintenance --- Sept 8
excerpt: Server maintenance on September 8th from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM UTC.
content: The server will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on September 8th from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM UTC. During this time, the server will be offline. We apologize for any inconvenience.
